pages.text: Drones are the heart of CyberFarm: modular flying workers that harvest, plant, dig, chop trees, carry items and even give you a ride, then fly home to unload and recharge.$(br)$(li)$(l:drone_systems/drone_assembler)Drone Assembler$(/l)$(br)$(li)$(l:drone_systems/drone_frames)Basic Drone Frame$(/l)$(br)$(li)$(l:drone_systems/modules)Harvester Module$(/l)$(br)$(li)$(l:drone_systems/addons)Speed Addon$(/l)

$(li)Pick a $(l)frame$() in $(l:drone_systems/drone_frames)Drone Frames$(/l): it decides battery, speed and how many modules and addons fit.$(br)$(li)Choose its jobs with $(l:drone_systems/modules)Function Modules$(/l).$(br)$(li)Tune it with $(l:drone_systems/addons)Addons$(/l): speed, bigger loads, battery, Fortune or Silk Touch.$(br)$(li)Put it all together in the $(l:drone_systems/drone_assembler)Drone Assembler$(/l).
pages.title: From parts to a working drone

pages.text: $(li)Give it a home: a powered $(l:drone_systems/drone_dock)Drone Dock$(/l), with a work area marked by the Survey Tool.$(br)$(li)Deploy it, change it and recover it as shown in $(l:drone_systems/drones)Using Drones$(/l).$(br)$(li)Watch the whole fleet at work on a $(l:drone_systems/hologram_table)Hologram Table$(/l).
